title: Journey Plan fixes A-D - before and after
sub: Same big demo company (600 shops, 20 salesmen). Left of each arrow: this morning's test. Right: the fixed app. Android = the Pixel 7 phone in the lab (Chrome 124). iPhone = a PC Chrome pretending to be an iPhone 13 opened from the home screen (notch drawn on, a simulation). Gold dashed box = something wrong.

sections.h: A + C. Full map on Android

pair.cap: Before, 412 wide. Map 839 px tall on a 783 px screen.
After. Map ends at the screen's bottom (71-783). All 6 keys show their names. Salesman row below the DEMO bar.
Before, 390 wide. Map 773 px tall on a 717 px screen.
After. Map 71-717 on a 717 screen. Keys at 631-689, names whole. Salesman row at y 84, below the DEMO bar.

sections.h: C. Full map on the iPhone home-screen app

pair.cap: Before. Keys already fit. Salesman row under the DEMO bar (y 60).
After. Keys in the same place (719-787 of 844). Salesman row at y 131, below the DEMO bar and the guide line.

sections.h: B. Find a shop while one salesman is pressed

pair.cap: Before. The map flies to empty streets and says nothing.
After, 412. A note says whose shop it is: DEDE SUPRIATNA's, not BAGUS SETIAWAN's.

sections.h: D. Demo: shops that bought today count as visited

pair.cap: After. Top: 264 visited = the 228 shops that bought + the 36 visited without buying. The live demo shows it after the next 00:05 WIB reset.
